comparison.objective: Clip a condenser onto a still head; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Aligning laboratory glassware and engaging a retaining clip versus recessed tool engagement, screw torque, fine collar rotation and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Condenser must be correctly seated and retained without damaging the apparatus; candidate requires a locked setting and two safe axial stops.
comparison.reason: Generic alignment and retention do not make glassware assembly a duplicate of damper adjustment and performance validation.
